title: sphere
body:
## sphere

Creates a triangulated polygonal sphere (vtkPolyData with point normals) of given radius about centre, with its poles on the z axis. resolution sets the number of longitude divisions around z (Schemaxis default 24, ParaView's own default 8); latitude divisions are fixed at 24 by Schemaxis. Use it as a marker, a target mesh for resample, a seed surface for streamTracer or simple test geometry; its coordinates are in the units of the data it is combined with.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Latitude resolution (PhiResolution) is fixed at 24, so a very high resolution gives long thin facets; use pvSphere to set ThetaResolution and PhiResolution together or to make a partial sphere.
- The facets lie inside the true sphere, so the surface area and enclosed volume are slightly smaller than the analytic values, noticeably so at low resolution.
- Schemaxis's serial native acceptance run (examples/schemaxis/extended-coverage.json) executes this operation once, with the default options; it does not check this operation's output values, so inspect the result on your own data.

Native constructor: `Sphere`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `centre` | This property specifies the 3D coordinates for the center of the sphere. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"number"},"minItems":3,"maxItems":3}` | `[0,0,0]` | `[0,0,0]` |
| `radius` | This property specifies the radius of the sphere. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true}` | `1` | `1` |
| `resolution` | The value of this property represents the number of divisions between Start Theta and End Theta around the sphere. (See the Start Theta and End Theta properties.) The theta divisions are similar to longitude lines on the earth. The higher the resolution, the closer the approximation will come to a sphere, and the more polygons there will be. | `{"type":"integer","minimum":3}` | `24` | `24` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "sphere"
}
```
